title: Puzzle 3D React Parity
description: Restore premigration parity for puzzle 3D in the React renderer: GLB coordinate frame, hover/select/gumball/marquee protocol, scene layers (vortices/attractions/target volumes/references/brush preview), and Select/Brush/Fill window engagements.
summary: Restored Puzzle 3D React renderer premigration parity: GLB meshes now use GLB_MESH_FRAME_ROTATION_X (Y-up→Z-up), puzzle3d plugin handles setHover/worldPick/setTransformTool and emits gumball-ready selection JSON, World3dHost renders vortices/attractions/target volumes/references/brush preview from extended World3dScene fields, and window_engagements exposes Select/Brush/Fill toolbar with brush candidate toggle and fill slider. Vitest: 21 passed. Native cargo test -p puzzle-plugin blocked by pre-existing wasm plugin_exports macro (same as other plugins).
